instruction: Create systemd service for GoAccess daemon
output:
<think>
Goal: The user wants to perform a system monitoring operation using cat.

Plan: `cat` is the appropriate choice — cat command execution and management. `goaccess` will be used for real-time web log analysis. `nginx` will be used for web server and reverse proxy.

Precautions: Check that the output path exists and is writable. Use `>>` to append instead of `>` if preserving existing content matters. After execution, validate that the system behaves as expected before closing the task.
</think>
cat > /etc/systemd/system/goaccess.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=GoAccess Dashboard
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/goaccess /var/log/nginx/access.log --real-time-html -o /var/www/html/report.html
Restart=always
User=www-data
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
